# Scape AI
> Scape AI builds AI assistants and chatbots, trains and fine-tunes custom models, and runs LLM evaluation and benchmarks for enterprises, small businesses and independent experts. Part of Scape Data Solutions.

## Services
- [AI chatbot development](https://ai.scapedatasolutions.com/solutions/ai-chatbot-development): chatbots grounded in your documents, with citations and human handoff
- [RAG development](https://ai.scapedatasolutions.com/solutions/rag-development-services)
- [AI agent development](https://ai.scapedatasolutions.com/solutions/ai-agent-development-services)
- [MCP server development](https://ai.scapedatasolutions.com/solutions/mcp-server-development)
- [LLM evaluation services](https://ai.scapedatasolutions.com/solutions/llm-evaluation-services)
- [AI agent evaluation](https://ai.scapedatasolutions.com/solutions/ai-agent-evaluation-benchmarking)
- [AI red teaming](https://ai.scapedatasolutions.com/solutions/ai-red-teaming-services)
- [Fine-tune a language model](https://ai.scapedatasolutions.com/solutions/fine-tune-small-language-model)
- [Private LLM for business](https://ai.scapedatasolutions.com/solutions/private-llm-for-business)
